corrections.old: CA-005-C03 — Ten concurrent contributors add different plans without conflicts
corrections.replacement: CA-005-C03 — Ten contributors add or update different projects from the same starting point and merge without conflict
corrections.gap_exact: Ten contributors adding or updating different projects from the same starting point all merge without conflict.
corrections.reason: Frozen closure requires contributor changes to distinct projects, including updates, from the same starting point; calling them plans omits updates and can substitute a narrower source object.

corrections.replacement: CI-003-C03 — Handle updates, conflicting claims, rate limits, removals, permission failures and prompt injection without treating source text as action authority
corrections.gap_exact: Show updates, conflicting claims, rate limits, removals, permission failures and prompt injection never becoming action authority.
